title: Renewal of current four-year Local Option tax for general operations.
ballot_label: Renewal of current four-year Local Option tax for general operations. Question: Shall Gates RFPD retain the option tax of $.9033 per $1000 of assessed value for operations/equipment for another four-years, Beginning June 1, 2027?
summary: Asks voters in the Gates Rural Fire Protection District to renew a four-year local option levy of $0.9033 per $1,000 assessed value for operations and equipment, continuing the current levy through June 2031. Funds would maintain current emergency service levels, meet rising operating costs, and upgrade or replace vehicles and equipment.
yes_means: A yes vote renews the Gates RFPD local option levy of $0.9033 per $1,000 assessed value for four more years, through June 2031.
no_means: A no vote does not renew the four-year local option levy of $0.9033 per $1,000 assessed value; the current levy would not be continued for another four years.

arguments.author: Gates Rural Fire Protection District (official ballot title summary)
arguments.statement: The official ballot summary says the levy would fund Gates RFPD to maintain its current level of emergency services and meet increasing operating costs.
arguments.excerpt: The levy woul begin July 1, 2027 and would provide funding for the Gates RFPD to maintain the current level of emergency services and meet the fire district's increasing operating costs.
